terms.title: Terms of use
terms.summary: The ground rules for using Manovia: you are in charge of your account and your entries, you must be old enough to consent in your country, and Manovia is a self-help companion — not therapy, not a diagnosis, and not a crisis service.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.summary: What we store (your account, your entries, safety metadata) and why. Chat, journal and mood text is encrypted at rest, is never sold, and can be erased by deleting your account.

ai_disclosure.title: AI disclosure
ai_disclosure.summary: Manovia is software, not a person. What you read here is generated by an AI.
ai_disclosure.text: Manovia is an AI-powered self-help companion. The replies you get are generated by an AI, not written by a human therapist or counsellor. It cannot diagnose you, cannot give medical or medication advice, and is not an emergency or crisis service — if you are in danger or thinking about harming yourself, please contact your local emergency services or a helpline right away. Sharing how you feel can still help you reflect and feel less alone. You are in control: you choose what to write, you can stop at any time, and you can delete your account and its data whenever you want.

store_chat.title: Chat history
store_chat.summary: Optional: let Manovia keep your conversations so you can look back at them. The text is stored encrypted, and withdrawing this consent stops future storage.
